text:
tara: quick ping 1 — encountering duplicate tokens after reconnect in the new streaming-samples when auth refresh happens mid-chunk. Repro on Node + browser.
ben: can you paste the raw SSE bytes you observed?
tara: server wrote:

id: 31415
data: {"tok":"one"}

id: 31416
data: {"tok":"two"}

proxy coalesced them, client read returned one buffer: `data...one
data...two
` (only one trailing blank line). Client aborts for auth refresh then reconnects with Last-Event-ID:31415 and server re-sends 31415 -> we see "one" twice.
ash: sounds like two problems: (1) relying on TCP/read boundaries for SSE (no go), (2) SDK not deduping by id across reconnects.
ben: what parser are you using? fetch+readable stream?
tara: yes, simple split-on-"\n\n" in example.
infra-bot: note: staging quickstart shows small spike in stream reconnects 2026-04-18T07:00Z :warning:
sdk-bot: recommended quick fixes: expose `id` on emitted event, add `sse.dedupeById` toggle (default off), and add `sse.partialFlushMs` to be lenient on newline boundaries.
ash: implementation idea: keep a small ring buffer (default capacity 512) of recent ids with TTL to GC. On parser/reconnect skip already-seen ids before delivering to user. Also optionally flush partial events after N ms when single-LF seen (configurable).
ben: add an integration test harness with nginx/haproxy that intentionally coalesces/splits frames and simulates auth refresh mid-stream.
tara: workaround for users: include an incrementing `seq` in event JSON and dedupe at app layer, or set server to immediate flush for SSE endpoints. I'll add a short note in quickstart docs.
ash: action items:
- ben: open SDK GH issues for Node+Go+Browser to add `dedupeById` + `partialFlushMs` with unit + integration tests
- ben: add nginx-based integ harness (docker-compose) and E2E that aborts mid-chunk and asserts no duplicate tokens when dedupe enabled
- tara: add reproducible example in examples/stream-reconnect and doc blurb about Last-Event-ID semantics
- infra-bot: scan ingress configs for buffering that could coalesce SSEs and report instances

tara: I'll open the example PR and link logs shortly. Thanks! :thumbsup:
